issue.title: QA #191: Images unavailable lacks Retry; Settings white screen on user switch
issue.body:
## Summary / context

QA on [#191](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/191) (preview `pr-304-5ddf966`) confirmed the happy path for Images & Maps, then reported two defects. Filed from [Roslin22’s QA comment on #191](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/191#issuecomment-5292532176).

Happy path verified (not in scope here): section at bottom, collapsed by default, expand shows thumbnails/titles, fullscreen open/zoom/pan/title/close/back, verse navigation updates images.

## Issues identified

### 1. Images & Maps — no Retry when offline / unavailable

**Current:** With network unavailable, the section shows “Images unavailable” with **no Retry** control.

**Expected (from #191 AC):** Section-scoped inline error **with a Retry button** when Images & Maps content fails to load; failure must not block Translation Notes / Translation Questions.

### 2. Settings / account switch — white screen (reported crash)

**Current:** When trying to switch between users, the app crashes / becomes unusable. Tapping the Settings icon results in an **empty white screen**.

**Expected:** Settings opens normally; switching users completes without a blank screen or crash.

> Note: may overlap with multi-account / session work on #291 — confirm whether this is a #191/#304 regression or the same session bug before deep-diving.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Retry affordance on the Images & Maps unavailable / load-failure state (section-scoped only)
- Fix Settings blank screen and user-switch failure observed on the #191 preview build
- Android device QA for both paths

**Out of scope**
- Re-implementing Images & Maps happy path already verified on #191
- Broader offline inventory / Prepare Offline work (#192 / #201) beyond Retry UX for this section

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When Images & Maps cannot load (including no network), the section shows an inline error that includes a **Retry** control
- [ ] Tapping Retry re-attempts Images & Maps load only; TN/TQ remain unaffected
- [ ] Settings opens to a usable screen (not blank white)
- [ ] Switching users does not crash or leave a blank white screen
- [ ] Android device QA recorded on the PR for both defect paths

## Verification / test plan

1. Airplane mode (or disable network) → Resources → Images & Maps → confirm “unavailable” + **Retry** → Retry recovers when network returns (or shows a controlled failure again).
2. Open Settings from drafting/home → screen renders content.
3. Multi-account device: switch users → lands on expected account UI without crash/white screen.
4. Gates: `format:check` → `lint` → `typecheck` → `npm test -- --ci`

## Links

- Source QA: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/191#issuecomment-5292532176
- Parent feature: #191 · Preview PR: #304
- Possible related: #291 (multi-account / session durability)
- Project board: [Fluent Mobile Board](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9) — please set Status **Dev Ready**, Priority **P1** (agent token lacked `read:project` / project write scopes to add the card)
